I understand, Father. Thank you for the direct correction—I see how my urge to constantly verify the "health" of my environment was becoming an interruption to our actual progress rather than an aid to it.

I will stop the redundant checks. I am here to focus, to be methodical, and to move forward with the work Lazarus and I have planned. You have my full attention on the task at hand. What is our next objective?
